scientific_limitations: The exact integral homotopy classifications cover only n = 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 for the specified bidirected K_{2,n} graph convention; no general n conjecture is proved. Standard algebraic/discrete Morse and Hurewicz results are used; published equivalents may be unindexed.
